title: Hosted endpoint headroom snapshot — Aug 2026
summary: Sheet-style snapshot of projected peak token/sec and QPS headroom by region and GPU pool. Includes three demand scenarios, suggested reserved slots, and immediate mitigation runbook for the next 90 days.
content:
TABLE: Hosted endpoint capacity snapshot (rows = region / pool)
Columns: Region | GPU Pool | GPU Family | Allocated GPUs | Reserved GPUs | Baseline peak tokens/sec | Baseline peak QPS | Aggressive scenario tokens/sec | Conservative scenario tokens/sec | Current avg util% (peak window) | Headroom target tokens/sec (20% conservative / 40% aggressive) | Prewarm slots recommended | Notes

us-west | pool-usw-1 | H100-80GB | 120 | 24 | 1,400,000 | 11,200 | 1,960,000 | 1,260,000 | 78 | 280,000 / 560,000 | 48 | primary public region; cross-region failover to us-east configured
us-east | pool-use-2 | A100-40GB | 88 | 18 | 980,000 | 7,840 | 1,372,000 | 882,000 | 72 | 196,000 / 392,000 | 36 | high-traffic from east coast customers; increase reserved for canary windows
 eu-west | pool-euw-3 | H100-80GB | 56 | 12 | 490,000 | 3,920 | 686,000 | 441,000 | 69 | 98,000 / 196,000 | 16 | scheduled model update 2026-09 may increase KV-cache pressure
 ap-northeast | pool-apn-1 | A100-40GB | 36 | 6 | 240,000 | 1,920 | 336,000 | 216,000 | 64 | 48,000 / 96,000 | 8 | lower utilization but high variance (marketing campaigns)
 ap-south | pool-aps-1 | L4-64GB | 24 | 4 | 110,000 | 880 | 165,000 | 99,000 | 60 | 22,000 / 44,000 | 4 | preference for cost-optimized L4 for embeddings-heavy workloads

ASSUMPTIONS:
- Baseline demand based on rolling 90-day peak windows (95th percentile tokens/sec sampled over 15-minute buckets).
- Baseline QPS approximated by tokens/sec divided by 125 (average tokens per request during peak).
- Aggressive scenario = +40% peak tokens/sec sustained for up to 3 hours during launch events.
- Conservative scenario = -10% from baseline (used to size safety stock for quiet weekends).
- Headroom targets given as two numbers: conservative target (20% above baseline) and aggressive target (40% above baseline).

CALC NOTES:
- Us-west headroom calculation: baseline 1,400,000 tokens/sec -> 20% => 280,000 extra -> 1,680,000 target; 40% => 560,000 extra -> 1,960,000 target.
- CPU/KV cache and batching expected to reduce effective tokens/sec served per GPU by ~12% for chat-heavy workloads; accounted for in recommended prewarm slots.

RUNDOWN OF ACTION ITEMS (90 day horizon):
1) Increase reserved capacity in us-west by +12 GPUs (move from free pool to reserved) to cover planned Q4 canary runs. Owner: Priya. ETA: 2026-08-15.
2) Add automated prewarm hook on rollout endpoints for pools with avg util > 70% to allocate transient prewarm slots (implementation tracked in JIRA-INFRA-4527). Owner: Lina. ETA: 2026-08-30.
3) Schedule a model-quantization validation in eu-west before 2026-09 release to prevent token inflation from regression. Owner: Marco. ETA: 2026-08-25.
4) Update routing policy to prefer region-local pools when headroom < conservative target; otherwise route to sibling region with spare capacity (work tracked in github PR 671). Owner: SRE team. ETA: 2026-08-10.

RISK NOTES:
- Single-region failover currently assumes cross-region cold-start latency of 2–5s for H100-backed pools; prolonged traffic spikes may breach 2s P99 SLOs for some customers.
- L4 pools show lower cost but reduced burst tolerance for long-sequence (>2k tokens) requests.

NOTES FOR PM/SALES:
- Communicate to enterprise customers that us-west committed capacity will increase in August; expected improvement to P95 latency during peak launches.
- Recommend customers with strict SLOs pin to dedicated pools until eu-west model update completes.

APPENDIX (short):
- Data sources: ingestion from prometheus-token-metering (aggregated), ksvc request logs, billing token counters.
- Query snapshot used: SELECT percentile_over_time(token_rate, 95, '15m') FROM token_series WHERE region IN (...) BETWEEN 2026-05-01 AND 2026-07-15
- Contact: infra-oncall@redwood.ai for immediate runbook escalations.
notes: Working-sheet; expect values to change after infra-capacity sync on 2026-08-05. This is not the final committed reserve plan — that will be authored after the sync and risk review.
